page_title: LEV 2-0 WOL | Bayer Leverkusen v Wolfsburg 10/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' Substitution. Exequiel Palacios will be replaced by Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen).
90' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Florian Wirtz and he is replaced by Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen).

89' Bayer Leverkusen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) coming on for Yannick Gerhardt.
87' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) replaces Cedric Zesiger.
86' 2 - 0 Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a sweet pass and scores with aplomb. His low drive goes in off the left post. Fabulous goal!
83' The corner from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence.

83' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Koen Casteels is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
82' Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
80' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
78' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Nathan Tella.
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Patrik Schick walks off the pitch to be replaced by Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen).
74' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
73' Daniel Siebert blows the whistle, Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) is penalised for a foul.
71' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar!

70' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
69' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
64' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' Substitution. Lovro Majer is replaced by Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg).
63' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Tiago Tomas will be replaced by Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg).
59' Substitution. Piero Hincapie makes his way off the pitch and Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as his replacement.
58' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
55' A pass by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
54' A lofted cross from Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
52' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
50' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) makes a strong challenge and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul.
48' Bayer Leverkusen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
47' A long pass, executed by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Koen Casteels steps in and intercepts a long pass from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
42' The free kick from long range, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' Referee Daniel Siebert sees the trip by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
41' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
40' Koen Casteels makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) after a cross from the side.
40' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
37' 1 - 0 Goal! Alejandro Grimaldo picks out Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the roof of the net with a header from close range. 1:0.
36' An attempted cross from Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared.
34' The possession of the ball – 59:41.
32' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jonas Wind.
32' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
31' None of the Bayer Leverkusen players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayer Leverkusen, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' RED CARD! Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Daniel Siebert. He can have an early bath.
27' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
26' Wolfsburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

25' What a wonderful moment! Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) receives a perfect pass in the middle of the pitch, lines up the ball and unloads a powerful strike towards the crossbar. His effort fails to surprise Lukas Hradecky, who makes a nice save.
23' What a miskick by Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
22' OFF THE POST! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the ball inside the box and unleashes a first-time shot that rattles the left post.
21' Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
20' Some neat passing and movement from Bayer Leverkusen as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
18' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.

17' The ball is laid off to Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Koen Casteels to make a decent save.
15' Cedric Zesiger (Wolfsburg) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
15' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
14' The foul by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) was seen by Daniel Siebert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
12' What was Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
11' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
10' A cross from Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
6' Wonderful movement by Bayer Leverkusen. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
3' A pass from Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Koen Casteels and the move breaks down.
2' Bayer Leverkusen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

1' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
